items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She told me about Gil Evans, oh you gotta meet Gil Evans, I said, “great,” and I fell in love with Gil immediately.

ctx.x: So she introduced you to Gil?
She told me about Gil Evans, oh you gotta meet Gil Evans, I said, “great,” and I fell in love with Gil immediately.
You’d heard the stuff he had written for, Thornhill then?
